edges.effect_quant: The average gain in time-trial performance is small, but repeated meta-analyses show that nitrate-rich beetroot can nudge endurance outcomes in the right direction, particularly with chronic loading.
edges.mechanism: Beetroot-derived nitrate boosts nitric-oxide availability, which can lower the oxygen cost of submaximal work and improve muscle perfusion under high demand. The edge is more about efficiency and fatigue resistance than about producing a large jump in maximal power.
edges.summary: The cleanest claim is that nitrate-rich beetroot offers a modest performance edge rather than a universal breakthrough. Reviews that isolate time-trial style outcomes usually find either a trivial positive effect overall or a clearer benefit when supplementation is repeated over several days instead of taken once.
edges.caveats: Effects are inconsistent in women and may shrink in highly trained athletes with already efficient nitrate handling. Mouthwash use, background diet, and whether the intervention is acute or chronic can all dilute the signal.
